message: How many days do I have to send something back?
reference: Most items can be returned within 30 days of delivery (60 days for Larkspur Plus members). Electronics have a shorter 15-day window (30 days for Plus members).

message: I opened the headphones I got last week and I don't like them. Can I still return them, and will it cost me anything?
reference: Yes, electronics can be returned within 15 days of delivery (30 for Plus members) with all accessories. Because they are opened and not defective, a 15% restocking fee is deducted from the refund (plus the $6.95 return label fee if using our label, unless a Plus member).

message: After you get my return, how long until the money is back on my credit card?
reference: The return is inspected within 2 business days of arrival and the refund is issued within 3 business days after it passes; the card's bank then takes 5 to 10 business days to post it.

message: I paid with PayPal. How quickly will a refund show up?
reference: PayPal refunds appear 3 to 5 business days after the refund is issued.

message: If I return something, do I get the original shipping fee back too?
reference: No. Original shipping charges are not refundable unless the return is the store's fault (defective item, damaged in transit, or wrong item sent).

message: How much is expedited shipping and how fast is it?
reference: Expedited shipping costs $14.99 and takes 2 to 3 business days.

message: Can you deliver to Toronto? Who pays customs?
reference: Yes, the store ships to Canada (and the UK). International delivery takes 10 to 20 business days and the customer pays any customs duties or import taxes on delivery.

message: I got a sweater 40 days ago and it's the wrong size. Is it too late to swap it for a larger one?
reference: It is not too late: size or color exchanges of the same item are allowed within 45 days of delivery, even though the return window is 30 days. The item must be unused with tags.

message: What does the warranty cover on an office chair, and for how long?
reference: Office chairs are covered for 5 years on the frame, 2 years on mechanisms such as gas lifts, tilt controls and casters, and 1 year on upholstery, foam and fabric.

message: I spilled coffee on my keyboard and now it doesn't work. Is that covered by the warranty?
reference: No. Liquid damage and other accidental damage are not covered by the limited warranty. Accidental damage, including spills, is covered only by a CareGuard protection plan.

message: Can I split a $25 order into payments with Klarna?
reference: No. Klarna pay-in-4 is only available on orders between $35 and $1,000, so a $25 order is not eligible.

message: Do your gift cards expire, and how many can I use on one order?
reference: Gift cards never expire and have no fees. Up to 5 gift cards can be used on one order.

message: How much does Larkspur Plus cost? Is there a free trial?
reference: Larkspur Plus costs $49 per year or $5.99 per month, with a 30-day free trial available once per customer.

message: I've had my annual Plus membership for two months. If I cancel now, do I get my money back?
reference: No. Annual memberships are only refunded in full when cancelled within the first 30 days with no benefits used. After 30 days there is no refund, but benefits continue until the end of the paid year.

message: How long do you keep my chat conversations with support?
reference: Support chat transcripts are kept for 90 days and then deleted.

message: I want you to delete all my personal data. How long does that take, and is everything removed?
reference: Deletion is completed within 45 days of the verified request. Records the law requires the store to keep, such as order and payment records, are kept until their retention period ends but are no longer used for marketing.

message: The price of a lamp I bought 10 days ago just dropped. Can I get the difference back?
reference: Yes. If the price drops within 14 days of purchase, the store refunds the difference once per order (not for flash sales, clearance or competitor prices). It goes back to the original payment method on the normal refund timeline.

message: Can I return a personalized engraved cutting board?
reference: No. Personalized or engraved items are final sale and cannot be returned or exchanged, though they are still covered by the warranty if defective.

message: I'm a Plus member. How long do I have to return a jacket, and do I have to pay for the return label?
reference: As a Plus member you have 60 days to return most items such as a jacket, and Plus members get free return labels on every return.

message: My package showed up crushed and the vase inside is broken. What should I do, and will I get my shipping cost back?
reference: Report it within 48 hours of delivery with photos of the box and the item, and keep the packaging. The store sends a free replacement or refunds the item including the shipping charge, since damage in transit is the store's responsibility.

message: If I cancel an order before it ships, when does the money come back on my card?
reference: An order cancelled before it ships is refunded in full. Cards are only authorized at order time and charged at shipment, so cancelling releases the authorization hold, which usually disappears within 3 to 7 business days depending on the bank.

message: I'm a Plus member and my speaker stopped working after 18 months. Is it still under warranty?
reference: Yes, if the membership was active on the purchase date: electronics have a 1-year warranty and Plus members get an extra year, for 2 years in total, so 18 months is still covered (batteries have shorter 6-month coverage).

message: What about for Plus members?
reference: Larkspur Plus members get 60 days for most items (and 30 days for electronics instead of 15).

history.content: Can I exchange a monitor that has dead pixels?
Electronics can be exchanged for the same model only because of a defect reported within 15 days of delivery [Exchanges Policy § What can be exchanged].

message: It's been two months though. Is it covered by the warranty instead?
reference: Yes. After 15 days defects are handled under the warranty, and electronics are covered against manufacturing defects for 1 year from delivery (2 years for Plus members), so a monitor with dead pixels after two months is covered.

message: And if I return something I bought with it, how long does the refund take?
reference: Apple Pay refunds follow the underlying card: 5 to 10 business days after the refund is issued.
